sections.kicker: Prepared for Renew Vitality by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Renew Vitality sounds like every hormone clinic. Its best line is hiding in a hero paragraph.
sections.keep: The headline, "Stop guessing. Start measuring." Short, confident and a clear stance.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.what: The line above the headline describes the category, not Renew.
pins.why: Every men's health clinic uses these words. A man comparing five clinics sees the same sentence five times.
pins.how: Say what Renew does differently in a sentence only Renew could write.
pins.label: Your descriptor
pins.cost: Renew competes on category words, and the clinic that spends most on ads wins.

pins.quote: a coordinator who knows your name
pins.what: The paragraph holds the one human detail on the page.
pins.why: It is the real difference from a faceless clinic and it sits in the third line of body copy.
pins.how: Show the coordinator, give them a name and put that where the headline is.
pins.label: Your paragraph
pins.cost: The most distinctive promise reads as small print.

pins.area: A dusk golf course with palm trees fills the hero behind the headline
pins.what: The hero photo is a golf course at dusk.
pins.why: It says leisure and wealth, not labs or measuring. The image pulls against the headline that says measure.
pins.how: Choose imagery that shows the measuring, the people or the result.
pins.label: Your photo
pins.cost: The picture says resort while the words say clinic, so neither sticks.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Renew Vitality. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Renew Vitality's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
